plugins.name: Audio description
plugins.description: Finds and tags films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track for blind and partially sighted people, plays it for the people who choose it, and prefers releases with one in Reelix.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Films to list and Series to list: how many Titles with audio description lists of each: All, or the last 10, 20, 50, 100 or 500 added to Jellyfin, newest first. Last 20 by default. A series counts by its newest described episode and still lists all its described episodes. The page says how many it shows, such as "Showing the last 20 of 143 films", and where to change it. Newest first: the films and series are listed by when they were added to Jellyfin, newest first. The nightly check keeps that date; select Check for described titles now once after updating.

plugins.name: Audio description tracks
plugins.description: Adds a description track you already have, such as one from AudioVault, to its film or episode in Jellyfin, after checking that the lengths match.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Rules 1.0: the track words, how a file name is read, how close the lengths must be (5 seconds by default), the languages and the new track's name and title come from the same rules file as Jellyfin's own Audio description plug-in, so the two add tracks in the same way. Idle beside the Jellyfin version: when Jellyfin's own Audio description plug-in is installed, this one adds nothing and its card says Idle, so the two never add the same track. Add tracks in Jellyfin instead.

plugins.name: Calibre-Web
plugins.description: Calibre-Web, a browser page for a Calibre library: read, search and send books to an e-reader. It reads your books folder and never changes it.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Logo description: where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Calibre-Web logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

plugins.name: Checkrr
plugins.description: Checkrr checks your films and series for damaged files each Sunday night and lists them. It only reports: it never deletes, moves or replaces a file, and reads your media read only.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Direct play
plugins.description: Makes your films and series play directly on the devices you choose, so Jellyfin does not convert them as they play: one file at a time, in the hours you choose.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Disk forecast

versions.changelog: Clearer words: the band says Filling fast, and the card says when each disk fills. Logo description: where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Disk forecast logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

plugins.name: Ad blocking

plugins.name: Picture shrinker
plugins.description: Shrinks the posters and photos of people Jellyfin keeps, so they take less space. You choose: keep a backup of each original, or shrink without a backup.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Remote access
plugins.description: Starboard, Jellyfin and Audiobookshelf away from home through Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel, with no port opened on your router.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Clearer messages with what to do: when it cannot reach Starboard it says so and to update Starboard, then Start again; an app it could not check says Not checked instead of saying it is missing; a missing app says to add it in Settings, Apps. Your Tailscale name: it checks whether Starboard opens at the name, says when it works, and otherwise gives the steps to add it to STARBOARD_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

plugins.name: Seerr
plugins.description: Seerr, a requests page for Jellyfin users. Reelix already has requests in Starboard, so most people do not need it.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Logo description: where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Seerr logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

plugins.name: Styles
plugins.description: 22 accessible styles for Display: six change every part of Starboard (cards, buttons, tabs, menus), checked for contrast.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

versions.changelog: Classic: Starboard's design before Mica (teal on cool blue-grey, square corners), now that Mica is Starboard's own style. Mica first: Mica, now Starboard's own design, is the first style, with the same colours as the design system's default. Every style keeps its own design on top of the new Mica design system: cards lift only in styles with elevated cards, and the hover on menus has a clear edge.
